transforms.name: normalized-status-signal
transforms.effect: USER_INPUT, PLANNER_RESPONSE, and ERROR_MESSAGE become synthesized turn events. Confidence is derived.

transforms.name: reduce-activity
transforms.effect: turn:started upserts activity kind other; completion retracts it; tool events upsert or retract tool activity.

transforms.name: project-status
transforms.effect: transitions.ts chooses working if a child is runnable, blocked if blockers remain, working if activity remains, otherwise idle.

transforms.name: derive-status-default
transforms.effect: host.pending forces idle. A missing runtime state becomes working. Otherwise the projected status is kept.

transforms.name: replica-passthrough
transforms.effect: For an agent row the replica copies status. It recomputes status only for a terminal whose window activity is joined.

transforms.name: readers
transforms.effect: List reads status at AgentList.tsx:144-199. Rain reads agent.status at RainView.tsx:217. Swarm uses status at bubble-model.ts:298-345. Spend reads it at spend-words.ts:145. Timeline laneStatus is timeline-lanes.ts:94-97. This path has no catalog pricing step.

transforms.name: window-passthrough
transforms.effect: window-rows spreads the agent row and does not recompute status.

defaults.when: runtime state is absent and the host run is not pending

transport.name: AgentMonitorService.consume
transport.contract: turn, tool, or monitor activity to deriveAgentRow
